The appearance of martensitic transformations in the TiNi alloy with a grain size of 20 nm can be explained by a high dislocation yield stress of the NC TiNi samples.
However, the ductility is generally determined by strain-induced martensitic transformation during deformation of the alloy even with a small grain size of 20 nm.
It is clearly obvious that the value of rm increases while a grain size decreases.

As it is known an increased rate sensitivity of ﬂow stress is usually due to development of grain boundary sliding (GBS), i.e., it is evident that GBS is considered as one of the main deformation mechanisms of the NC alloy.
